proves.claim: The submit command reads the item's changed files from Git in its own step before the preflight dry-run opens its write transaction.

cli.io-submit-preflight-hold.git-files-r.why: Without it, a Git read inside the dry-run would hold the board write lock for seconds under load again.

proves.claim: The preflight dry-run's callbacks use the files already read and run no Git reader inside the write transaction.

cli.io-submit-preflight-hold.dry-run-cal.why: Without it, a Git subprocess inside the rolled-back transaction would hold the board write lock past its budget again.
